notes: AcrobatMotor.CheckInitFall/CheckFallingDamage measures net departure-to-landing displacement; no direct Jumping-skill mitigation.
PlayerHealth.ApplyPlayerFallDamage truncates5*(distance-5) to integer damage. PlayerFootsteps dispatches the original one-shot cues.

Project integration uses feet coordinates, verified stair support, explicit climbing suspension, and clears fall history on resets/load/teleports. Normal movement, jump height and collision tuning remain unchanged.
Swimming/slowfall/levitation/rappelling are not implemented by this milestone.
